pages.text:
Tunnels on the same frequency share one buffer of FE, heat, liquid, gas and items, wherever they are, in any dimension. A tunnel works while its chunk is loaded (a Chunk Loader or a Chunk Loading Upgrade keeps it loaded); the buffer itself is kept with the world, not the block.
- FE 4,000,000, heat 400,000 HU, liquid 64,000 mB, gas 64,000 mB, 9 item slots (config).
- Each output face pushes up to 4,194,304 FE/t (configurable), matching the default Superconducting Energy Conduit. Heat, fluid, gas and items keep their Arcforged rates. The shared FE buffer must be supplied fast enough for the connected load.

# Frequencies
Type a name and press Set to put the tunnel on it (making it if it's new).
- Public (open padlock): anyone may use it.
- Private (closed padlock): you, and players you trust at your Security Terminal.
Click a frequency in the list to switch; click the one it's on to leave it. The x deletes one you made, and everything in its buffer. Each player may make 32.

# Sides
Every face starts with a blank port. In the grid, set each face for each resource: None, Input (it takes that into the frequency) or Output (it gives it, pushing into the block it touches). The port shows a blue ring for input, orange for output, both for a face doing each.
# Security
The tunnel belongs to whoever placed it and follows the usual security; on a private frequency its owner must be the frequency's owner or trusted, or it does nothing.

# Chunk Loading Upgrade
Right-click a tunnel with one to fit it; sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take it out. Breaking the tunnel drops it.
- The tunnel keeps its own chunk loaded for its owner, like a Chunk Loader at radius 0, across restarts.
- It counts toward your chunk limit and follows the Chunk Loader settings (owner online, FE per chunk). Any FE comes from the frequency's buffer, so then it needs a frequency.
- Jade shows what it's doing.
